name: Go Fashion (India) Ltd
title: Go Fashion (India) Ltd - 543401 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Go Fashion is shutting small EBOs and pivoting to 700+ sq ft stores while SSSG is negative (~-3%) and Q4 EBITDA margin fell to 25.3%; management guides no degrowth and margin recovery only from Q2, with no numeric guidance.

triggers.label: Reported SSSG negative (~-3% to -3.5%)
triggers.quote: Sameer Gupta: Okay. So basically, even if you exclude the closed stores, it's still a 3%, 3.5% decline.

triggers.label: Inventory days up to 4 months
triggers.quote: this inventory level what we have currently at 4 months; in FY '27, it will stabilize again back to 3 months

triggers.label: No net store count guidance; sq ft +10%
triggers.quote: We would be adding at least more than 10% more square feet in the coming year.

triggers.label: Gross margin held 62.5%-63.5%, no discounting
triggers.quote: we'll maintain between that 62.5% and 63.5% gross margin, what we've been delivering.

guidance.quote: we'll maintain between that 62.5% and 63.5% gross margin, what we've been delivering.
We would be adding at least more than 10% more square feet in the coming year.
we are committed to turning SSG positive and ending FY '27 with a positive full year same-store sales growth.
By the end of FY '27, we plan to expand the Daily Wear concept to about 25 to 30 stores
we should see a good recovery in margins. Difficult to give a guidance on how much percentage

red_flags.label: Negative SSSG despite store closures
red_flags.quote: even if you exclude the closed stores, it's still a 3%, 3.5% decline.

red_flags.label: Inventory days elevated to 4 months
red_flags.quote: this inventory level what we have currently at 4 months

red_flags.label: Volume falling, ASP up ~9%
red_flags.quote: your ASP has increased by about 9-odd percent and your volume per store has dipped by about 11%, 12-odd percent

red_flags.label: Pre-Ind AS EBITDA margin 11.5% FY26 vs 16.8%
red_flags.quote: pre-Ind AS EBITDA is 11.5% and last year was 16.8%
